integrity: Complete analytic proof and reproducible stand-alone numerical checker supplied. The finite checker is independent of the Fourier integral derivation but is not a universal mathematical certificate. No outside scientific validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is confined to shortest-arc distance on the unit circle, damping a>0, and a real affine distance correction. It does not address other spheres or periodically wrapped Matérn kernels. Novelty is established only against inspected and indexed literature, not all unindexed work.
title: Exact signed linear-Laplace covariance interval on the geodesic circle
